fact: At the 11 September 2026 session of the Conseil national de la statistique, the INSD director general described the 2026-2030 schema directeur de la statistique as the new framework governing statistical activities, and the 2027 national statistical programme as aligned with it.

The INSD plan states Burkina Faso drew up and implemented successive statistics master plans (SDS), the latest being the SDS 2021-2025; the document gives no adoption date, so its published date of 2025-10-01 is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SDS 2026-2030.
